notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: Qwen3-8B language backbone read from MOSS-TTS-v1.5 config.json language_config (36 layers, 8 kv heads, head_dim 128, 32 query heads, full attention, sliding_window null): 36 x 8 x 128 x 2 (K+V) x 2 bytes = 147,456 B/token per LM position, where one position carries one delay-pattern frame of the 32 audio codebooks (n_vq 32). context 40,960 = language_config.max_position_embeddings.
